The StatefulSet `app` has a volume claim template (`storageClassName: fast-ssd`) requesting a StorageClass that does not exist in the cluster. The only class present is `standard` (default, provisioner `rancher.io/local-path`). Because of this mismatch, every claim stayed `Pending` and the external provisioner kept logging `ProvisioningFailed: storageclass.storage.k8s.io "fast-ssd" not found`, so no PVC was ever bound → `0/2` ready.

Evidence from observed state:

The StatefulSet's own manifest referenced a non-existent class: `storageClassName: fast-ssd`. The fix therefore had to supply a provisionable class or use an existing one. `rancher.io/local-path` is already present in this cluster as the default class, so I used that.
